items.source: Factory method to crate a new JsonWriter.ValueProcessor that applies the given action.
items.translation: 工厂方法用于创建一个新的JsonWriter.ValueProcessor，以应用给定的操作。

items.source: a new JsonWriter.ValueProcessor that only applies when the path matches
items.translation: 一个新的JsonWriter.ValueProcessor，仅当路径匹配时应用。

items.source: a new JsonWriter.ValueProcessor that only applies when the predicate matches
items.translation: 一个新的JsonWriter.ValueProcessor，仅在谓词匹配时应用。

items.source: a new JsonWriter.ValueProcessor instance
items.translation: 一个新的JsonWriter.ValueProcessor实例

items.source: path - the patch to match
items.translation: path - 要匹配的补丁

items.source: predicate - the predicate that must match
items.translation: predicate - 必须匹配的谓词

items.source: Callback interface that can be applied to JsonWriter.Members to process values before they are written. Typically used to filter values, for example to reduce superfluous information or sanitize sensitive data.
items.translation: 可应用于applied到JsonWriter.Members的回调接口，用于在写入之前处理值。通常用于过滤值，例如减少冗余信息或清理敏感数据。

items.source: Process the value at the given path.
items.translation: 处理给定路径处的值。

items.source:
Return a new processor from this one that only applies to member with values
that match the given predicate.
items.translation: 返回一个新的处理器，该处理器仅适用于成员值与给定谓词匹配的情况。

items.source:
Return a new processor from this one that only applied to members with the
given path.
items.translation: 返回一个新的处理器，该处理器仅应用于具有给定路径的成员。

items.source:
Return a new processor from this one that only applied to members that match
the given path predicate.
items.translation: 返回一个新的处理器，该处理器仅应用于匹配给定路径谓词的成员。

items.source:
Return a new processor from this one that only applied to members with the
given path (ignoring escape characters).
items.translation: 返回一个新的处理器，该处理器仅应用于具有给定路径的成员（忽略转义字符）。

items.source:
Return a new processor from this one that only applies to member with values of
the given type.
items.translation: 返回一个新的处理器，该处理器仅适用于具有给定类型值的成员。

items.source: T - the value type
items.translation: T - 值类型

items.source: value - the value being written (may be null)
items.translation: value - 正在写入的值（可能为 null）

items.source: a new JsonWriter.ValueProcessor that only applies when value is the given type.
items.translation: 一个新的JsonWriter.ValueProcessor，仅当值为给定类型时应用。

items.source: T - the value type
items.translation: T - 值类型

items.source: T - the value type
items.translation: T - 值类型

items.source: path - the path of the member containing the value
items.translation: path - 包含该值的成员的路径

items.source: type - the type that must match
items.translation: type - 必须匹配的类型

items.source: type - the value type
items.translation: type - 值类型

items.source: action - the action to apply
items.translation: action - 要应用的操作

items.source: the processed value
items.translation: 处理后的值

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。

items.source: Phillip Webb, Moritz Halbritter
items.translation: Phillip Webb，Moritz Halbritter
